youtube.title: Do you need disposable towels for ideal skin? #Shorts
youtube.description:
We checked the claim that disposable towels give you ideal skin. Dermatology guidance says towels can pass on some skin infections, so don't share them. None of the guidance we read says disposable towels improve skin, so the receipt total is UNKNOWN. Education, not medical advice.
